name: Tianzhou-2
about: Tianzhou-2 (2021-046A), a crewed vehicle (Tianzhou), launched 2021 May 29. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2021 May 30), held fixed
docked to S48274; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
